test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
He tried to make up** the real meaning behind her silence, but failed.
solution:
The correct answer is '**4**' i.e. 'Make out'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "**make out**" is used to mean "understand or decipher something that is difficult to comprehend."
 
• In the given sentence, the subject is trying to understand the real meaning of her silence, which aligns with the usage of "make out."
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are incorrect because they do not fit the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He tried to make **out**__ the real meaning behind her silence, but failed."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Make for"** is incorrect because it means "to move towards something" and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "Make on"** is incorrect as it is not a valid phrasal verb in standard usage.
 
• **Option 3: "Make about"** is incorrect because it is not commonly used as a phrasal verb and does not convey the intended meaning.
